description: Image Description: A close-up shot captures a stemmed glass filled with a pinkish-red beverage, likely a cocktail or rosé wine, placed on the edge of a wooden surface near a swimming pool. The glass is positioned slightly off-center to the right, with its base casting a soft shadow on the wood. The liquid inside the glass reflects light, creating subtle highlights and giving it a shimmering appearance. In the background, the turquoise water of the pool is visible but blurred, suggesting a shallow depth
